findings.title: Router-class on('didTransition') GA pageview handler never fires in Ember 5.12

remediation.options: Replace the dead Router-class event listener with a RouterService 'routeDidChange' subscription (as routes/application.js already does with this.router.on('routeWillChange', ...)). Inject router: service() and register the GA pageview send in init() via this.router.on('routeDidChange', ...), reading this.router.currentURL / currentRouteName instead of this.get('url').

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-boot-routing finder on 2026-07-19. Breakage class A6 (KB docs/ember-upgrade/KNOWN-ISSUES.md:61) / audit Class 5 removed-API. Reachability proof: router.js:35-44 registers notifyGoogleAnalytics via Router.reopen. Verified against ember-source 5.12 dist: defaultDidTransition performs only updatePaths/notifyPropertyChange and does NOT trigger 'didTransition'; only 'routeWillChange'/'routeDidChange' are emitted. GA pageview tracking silently stopped. router.js last changed 2026-07-11, after the 2026-07-09 sweep; not on any verified-safe list. Low severity: analytics-only, no AAC communication-path impact. | adversary: confirmed. No trigger('didTransition') anywhere in ember-source 5.12 dist; the triggerEvent('didTransition') near-miss dispatches to Route actions hashes (which still fire), not the router's Evented emitter; nothing in app/ triggers it manually. GA handler is dead code; low appropriate (window.ga-gated, analytics-only).

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-build-tests finder on 2026-07-19. Class 9 (build pipeline / addon compatibility). ember-cli-babel ^8.2.0 (package.json:49) peer-requires @babel/core, and ember-cli-build.js:8-10 directly references three @babel/plugin-transform-* packages. None appear in package.json devDependencies (verified at SHA; devDependencies only lists @babel/eslint-parser and @babel/plugin-proposal-decorators). They resolve today only transitively/hoisted in package-lock.json - a lockfile regen or dedupe change could de-hoist and break the build. Matches KB Build section. Builds green today; latent. | adversary: confirmed (factual claims hold; risk mechanism overstated). All three transform plugins are ember-cli-babel's OWN runtime dependencies and @babel/core is its peerDep (npm>=7 auto-installs), so a plain lockfile regen re-installs them; residual risk is narrower: strict-nesting package managers (pnpm no-hoist) or a future version conflict de-hoisting the string-name resolution from ember-cli-build.js. Low hygiene finding stands with softened framing.

findings.title: Button Settings lost the per-button "Show only text (as large as fits)" checkbox in the Ember 5.12 tab-template consolidation; model.text_only is still persisted server-side but no longer settable from any UI

remediation.options: The Ember 5.12 upgrade (8ad379acb) consolidated the per-tab editor templates (button-settings-general/picture/action/sound/extras/language.hbs) into components/button-settings.hbs. The Picture tab's text_only checkbox did not survive: the original fork carries it at app/frontend/app/templates/button-settings-picture.hbs:240 as {{input checked=model.text_only type="checkbox"}} with locale key 'stretch_text_only'. Its sibling hide_label control DID survive and is the anchor line here. The property is still persisted (app/models/board.rb:2239 allowlist, coerced to bool at :2248) and is still honored by the classic renderers (templates/button.hbs, button-unbound.hbs, board/index.hbs), so the data path is intact and only the control is missing. FIX PART 1: re-add the checkbox next to hide_label bound to model.text_only, using the modern one-way idiom (native input + (set-field this "model.text_only" "checkbox")), and restore the 'stretch_text_only' locale string, which was also dropped. FIX PART 2 (REQUIRED, separate defect that PREDATES the upgrade): the modern board-detail render path ignores per-button text_only entirely - components/board-detail-grid.hbs has zero references to it and controllers/user/board-detail.js#_make_btn never carries it onto the display button - so restoring the checkbox alone leaves the feature visually inert on the board view users actually see. Both halves are needed. Note PR #699 adds a DIFFERENT, adjacent mechanism (text_symbol, auto-detected for any labelled image-less button); it is not a substitute for the author-controlled text_only toggle and the two should not share a flag.

findings.title: Button Settings lost all three TarHeel book option checkboxes (book.popup / book.speech / book.utterance) in the Ember 5.12 consolidation, leaving a live bookChanged observer syncing a model no UI can edit

remediation.options: The original fork exposes three checkboxes on the Action tab: 'Show book in a popup' (model.book.popup, button-settings-action.hbs:311), 'Automatically read pages aloud' (model.book.speech, :343) and 'Add spoken pages to the vocalization box' (model.book.utterance, :353). components/button-settings.hbs now contains zero 'book' occurrences - only a hint string mentioning TarHeel Reader - while the component JS retains the full book machinery: this bookChanged observer, a load_book observer that queries /api/v1/search/external_resources?source=tarheel_book, and book_status state. The VIDEO equivalents survived the consolidation (model.video.popup checkbox at button-settings.hbs:930), which is what makes this a consolidation omission rather than an intentional removal. Impact is bounded but real: utils/button.js:163-175 (resource_from_url TarHeel init) defaults popup:true, speech:false, utterance:true — so the book pane still opens and spoken pages are added to the vocalization box by default, but authors can never turn popup/utterance OFF and can never turn speech ON. Restore the three checkboxes in the Action/Link section using the modern set-field idiom, mirroring how model.video.popup is bound. ALSO extend bookChanged (button-settings.js:348) to observe model.book.popup / model.book.speech / model.book.utterance (same nested-mutation pattern already documented for videoChanged at :336-342), or call editManager.change_button from each control — otherwise set-field will mutate the in-modal book object without synchronizing the authoritative board button.

The property is still persisted (app/models/board.rb:2239 allowlist). Note the current editor DOES have a skin_preference BoundSelect (button-settings.hbs:401) but that is the image-SEARCH skin preference, a different setting, and a comment at :268 confirms the search-scoped skin option was deliberately relocated - the per-button toggle was not. Confidence is medium rather than high because the whole skin-tone surface is gated behind the skin_tones feature flag, so this may be judged low-priority rather than a must-fix. Restore the conditional checkbox in the Picture section if per-button skin locking is still wanted.

findings.title: Button Settings lost the 'Require menu action to return from linked board' checkbox (model.meta_home) in the Ember 5.12 consolidation; it can now only be inherited on copy, never set

remediation.options: The original fork exposes this on the Action tab at button-settings-action.hbs:617 as {{input checked=model.meta_home type="checkbox"}} labelled 'Require menu action to return from linked board', nested under the home_lock option. The parent home_lock control DID survive (button-settings.hbs:687) but its meta_home sub-option did not, so an author can lock a linked board as a temporary home but can no longer require a menu action to leave it. The property is still persisted (app/models/board.rb:2239 allowlist, with an explicit delete-if-falsy at :2240) and app-state/board routes still read a meta_home navigation state. This line is the only remaining write and merely propagates an existing value during copy. Confidence is medium because the derive-from-home_lock behaviour here could plausibly have been an intentional simplification; confirm intent before restoring, then re-add the nested checkbox under the home_lock control.
